scope: Native projectile shield reentry independent of damage history; original Sticky flight and PlayerExplosion defense exceptions.
rules: Track current overlaps for all entered reflection-capable actors, including inactive shields and damage-ignored entries. Reentry can reflect an earlier damaged target, but switching a shield on while still inside cannot.
Independent overlap entries support multiple simultaneous reflectors; ordinary nonreflecting actors allocate no overlap map and retain permanent damage-ignore behavior.
Recheck live shield state during ordered resolution: an earlier collision can kill a later queried candidate.

GrenadeMineProjectile.shoot disables its flight hitbox; it still attaches beside a shield. PlayerExplosion.start_explosion sets hitbox.from=self after WeaponService.explode calls set_from, so the explosion is not a RangedWeapon/Pet-origin interception.
interfaces: EnemySim.isProjectileDeflecting(id)->active:boolean,capable:boolean; first return preserves existing boolean callers; dead/missing actors return false,false.
Projectile defense.active optionally returns second capability boolean. Production always supplies both; boolean-only active adapters remain valid for active shields.
Shot.defenseOverlaps replaces the single deflectFrom marker; damage-ignore data remains separate. No remote/schema/Arsenal change.
